# frontier-agent-legal-record

Private append-only audit log of Cursor agent actions — a legal/personal record with hash-chain integrity.

## Purpose

Cursor Gate writes ephemeral audit lines to `~/.cursor/gate-logs/`. This repository is the **durable, tamper-evident ledger** for:

- Gate review outcomes (per file, per reviewer)
- Imported gate audit JSONL and per-run JSON from local gate logs
- Explicit agent action events (commits, cloud runs, task boundaries)

Each entry is append-only JSONL with `prev_hash` → `entry_hash` chaining. Tampering breaks the chain.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Record a generic agent action
python3 scripts/record-action.py record --event agent_task_start --field repo Schema --field branch main

# Verify chain integrity
python3 scripts/record-action.py verify

# Import new lines from ~/.cursor/gate-logs/
python3 scripts/sync-gate-logs.py

# Run gate on a file (also records to legal log when record-action.py is present)
bash scripts/gate-file.sh --file samples/hello_passing.py
```

## Layout

```
legal_record/           # Hash-chained audit logger
records/
  agent_actions.jsonl   # Append-only event log (committed)
  chain_head.json         # Latest entry_hash pointer
  sync_state.json         # Dedup hashes for gate-log import
scripts/
  record-action.py        # CLI: record / record-gate / verify
  sync-gate-logs.py       # Pull from ~/.cursor/gate-logs/
  gate-file.sh            # Gate + legal record hook
```

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `LEGAL_RECORD_DIR` | `./records` | Directory for JSONL + chain head |
| `LEGAL_RECORD_ACTOR` | `cursor-agent` | Actor label on each entry |
| `GATE_LOG_DIR` | `~/.cursor/gate-logs` | Source for sync-gate-logs |

## Cursor Gate bootstrap

This repo includes the full Cursor Gate stack (15-gate reviewers, CI, agent rules). Bootstrapped from [zowskyy/Schema](https://github.com/zowskyy/Schema).
